analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 27,475) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 32,944/38,592/45,639) — Below, confirming short-term and mid-term trend weakness.
· SMA100/200 (KRW 41,065/31,372) comparison — Both below, indicating weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (35.7%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.4→30.4) + Oversold condition sustained + Downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-895.0898→-895.0898) + Maintained, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band KRW 28,600) + Bandwidth at 51.78% and widening.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 26,385) + Support expected based on Pivot S1 (KRW 17,763).
· Swing Resistance (KRW 30,570) + Potential for short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower Low) + Downtrend confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.85x) + Spike in volume not reflected in price rebound, reducing confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + RSI remains oversold, MACD shows no improvement, maintaining observation conditions.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 연속 하락세 속에서 거래량 급증은 단기적 되돌림 가능성을 시사하나, MACD 개선이 없어 추세 전환으로 보기에는 이르다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The surge in volume during the 5-day downtrend suggests potential for a short-term pullback, but the lack of MACD improvement makes a trend reversal unlikely.
keyPoints: RSI 과매도 구간 지속 및 MACD 개선 미흡으로 인한 관망 유지
거래량 급증에도 불구하고 가격 반등 실패, 하단 볼린저밴드 근접
주봉 ADX 45.3으로 뚜렷한 추세 지속, 일봉상 약세 흐름 강화
keyPointsEn: Maintaining observation due to sustained RSI oversold conditions and lack of MACD improvement.
Price failed to rebound despite volume surge, approaching lower Bollinger Band.
Strong downtrend confirmed by weekly ADX at 45.3, reinforcing bearish trend on daily chart.
analysis.riskNote: 현재가 27,475원 대비 ATR 3,720원(13.54%)으로 변동성이 크므로, 손절 기준을 ATR의 1.5배(약 5,580원)로 설정하여 21,895원 부근으로 잡는 것이 합리적이다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ATR at KRW 3,720 (13.54%) relative to the current price of KRW 27,475, volatility is high; setting a stop loss at approximately KRW 21,895 (1.5x ATR) is reasonable.
analysis.continuity: 3일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 과매도 구간 진입 및 MACD 개선 중이라는 직전 판단과 달리, RSI는 과매도 구간에 머물러 있고 MACD 개선은 미흡하여 관망을 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: Observation maintained for the 3rd consecutive day. Unlike the previous assessment of RSI entering oversold territory and MACD improving, RSI remains oversold and MACD shows minimal improvement, thus observation continues.
